name: Shigatsu no Yuusha-sama
source:
"None of the cherry blossoms around the world bloomed yet. This is a worldwide threat!"

...Said "The Signal of Spring" hero, Haruto.

While I thought it was stupid from the bottom of my heart, I... "The Holy Girl Beckoned from a Parallel Universe (according to Haruto)", decided to accompany Haruto on his "trip to make the cherry blossoms bloom".


Made for April Fools' Day.

When you play the game from the second playthrough onwards, the truth will become apparent.

[Translation of [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6621]Freem summary[/url].]
